role: The six block faces (DOWN/UP/NORTH/SOUTH/EAST/WEST) with their D-U-N-S-E-W order, the U-D-S-N-W-E order, and front offsets in each axis.

members.name: DOWN..WEST
members.sig: the 6 enum constants with order_a, order_b, frontOffsetX/Y/Z
members.note: static constants grouped; natively a face is the plain int 0..5

members.name: order_a
members.note: the D-U-N-S-E-W order is implicit in native side indexing

members.name: order_b
members.note: the U-D-S-N-W-E order is implicit in native side indexing

members.name: frontOffsetX
members.note: world.c FACE_X/FACE_Y/FACE_Z mirror Facing's per-side offsets, which EnumFacing's front offsets equal

notes: Natively faces are ints 0..5 used directly by renderer and placement code; there is no named EnumFacing port, only per-file tables. Facing.oppositeSide's native twin is place.c FACING_OPPOSITE_SIDE.
